subject: Clarify SOC 2 effective dates & snapshot coverage for procurement review
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 question — are year-end snapshots included?

Hi Mina,

We're doing a procurement compliance check and the GRC team requested clarification on the Redwood SOC 2 Type II coverage. The procurement questionnaire asks two things I want to confirm with you quickly:

1) Effective/reporting period — does your most recent Type II report cover Jan 1, 2024 through Dec 31, 2024 (inclusive)?
2) Point-in-time evidence — for a vendor control that references a year-end snapshot (2024-12-31 23:59 UTC), can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report or supporting artifacts include that point-in-time? If not, would Redwood provide a bridge letter or other attestation to cover our contract start date (we're targeting 2025-03-01)?

We have a deadline to submit answers to procurement on 2025-02-21. If you can confirm the dates and whether you can provide either (a) a signed bridge letter that covers Jan–Mar 2025 or (b) explicit point-in-time evidence for 2024-12-31 (examples: server config export, signed change-control log export, or retained audit log excerpt), that would be perfect.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

—Oliver
Oliver Grant
Security Program Manager, Acme Analytics
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 question — are year-end snapshots included?

Hi Oliver — thanks for the clear questions and the deadline heads-up. Quick answers up front, followed by detail and next steps.

Short answers:
- Effective/reporting period: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period Jan 1, 2024 through Dec 31, 2024 (inclusive). We will attach the report PDF for your team to review.
- Point-in-time inclusion: The Type II report documents control operation over the period, but it does not always include raw point-in-time exports. We can provide either point-in-time artifacts where available or a bridge letter to attest to continuity for the gap between the report end date and your contract start date.

Details & options:
1) Report: Attached is "SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024.pdf" — the auditor's report and the control narrative reference the full Jan–Dec 2024 period.

2) Point-in-time artifacts: For some controls (config management, change control, audit log retention) we can produce time-bound exports. Typical artifacts we can provide on request:
   - Signed change-log export (csv) with UTC timestamps
   - Configuration snapshot of provisioned inference fleet (json export) for a requested timestamp
   - Retained audit-log excerpts showing relevant events around the date/time you cite

3) Bridge letter: If procurement requires explicit attestation covering your contract start date (2025-03-01) we can provide a bridge letter that states operations and controls remained consistent from 2025-01-01 through 2025-03-31. That would be a signed letter from our Head of Security and Counsels. I am attaching a draft bridge-letter for your review and internal routing.

Next steps — tell us which you'd prefer by Tue 2025-02-18: (A) Deliver the point-in-time artifacts for 2024-12-31 23:59 UTC, or (B) accept the bridge letter (we'll sign and provide countersigned copy). We can do both if your team prefers.

I have looped in Marcus (security ops) and Lauren (privacy/compliance) to scope the artifact exports and Karthik from Legal for the bridge letter signature.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024.pdf (PDF), bridge-letter-draft-20250101-20250331.docx (DOCX)
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme-analytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 question — are year-end snapshots included?

Thanks Mina — that helps. A couple of quick clarifications from GRC:

- They specifically need confirmation that the artifact exports can show system state as of 2024-12-31 23:59:00 UTC (not just activity logs). For example, a config snapshot or inventory export with that timestamp that demonstrates the control state.
- For the bridge letter, procurement asks that it explicitly name the report being bridged (SOC2 Type II for the period Jan 1, 2024–Dec 31, 2024) and the exact bridge window (e.g., Jan 1, 2025–Mar 31, 2025).
- They also request the signer and title for the bridge letter (we typically accept Head of Security or General Counsel).

If you can confirm those three bullets and indicate turnaround time (we need final artifacts/letter by 2025-02-21), we'll route to procurement.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — we can jump on a 20-min call if that helps.

—Oliver
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 question — are year-end snapshots included?

Hi Oliver — final confirmation items below and proposed next steps.

Confirmation:
- We can produce a configuration/inventory snapshot exported with a timestamp of 2024-12-31 23:59:00 UTC where a snapshot exists. For managed components (Redwood-managed inference nodes, control-plane config) we will supply the exported JSON manifest and a signed hash (SHA256) for tamper-evidence.
- The bridge letter draft we provided references the SOC 2 Type II report for Jan 1, 2024–Dec 31, 2024 and proposes the bridge window Jan 1, 2025–Mar 31, 2025. The letter will be signed by our Head of Security (Marcus Lin) and countersigned by Legal (Karthik Iyer) upon final approval.
- Turnaround: if you confirm you want the artifacts and the signed bridge letter, we can deliver both by End of Day 2025-02-21. Artifacts will be provided in secure, time-limited Drive links and the signed bridge letter as a PDF.

Next steps:
1) Reply to confirm: (A) artifacts for 2024-12-31 23:59 UTC, (B) bridge letter, or (C) both.
2) If artifacts requested: tell us the specific control areas you want included (e.g., config snapshot + audit-log excerpt + change-log).

If preferred, Marcus and I can join a brief call to align with procurement's exact evidence needs.

Thanks — I'll start preparing artifacts and the bridge-letter signature flow once you confirm.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
